title: En+anced Plus
description: The best Vanilla+ experience by Enhancing the look and feel of Minecraft
body:
# En+anced Plus!
My modpack is finally out after a long time I have been prefecting it

The modpack focuses on the looks and feels of minecraft but doesnt add something new to the game it adds everything that can make minecraft be better by look


<details>
<summary>for example:</summary>

- HMI first person animations
- Atmospheric fog
- Fresh animations
- Fresh player animations
- and so much more more!


</details>


## Attention
**if you find any bugs or any requests of ideas you can alert them to me on discord
shy3383**

**If you have a low end pc or laptop the modpack wont work as best as high end pc's
because of that i am working on a lite version of this pack that will be a lot more optimized**
